ordinance_area_text: Except as hereinafter provided, all hunting with firearms or other weapons, including bow and arrow, is prohibited in the following designated subdivisions or other areas of the County which, in the opinion of the Board of Supervisors, are so heavily populated as to make such hunting dangerous to the inhabitants thereof. There shall be erected appropriate signs where they may reasonably be seen, designating the boundaries of said subdivisions and areas in which hunting is prohibited. However, this chapter shall not prohibit hunting by bow and arrow by a property owner on such owner's own property in such subdivision, provided that such hunting is done at least 100 yards from residences and roads. A. Within the boundary lines of Skyland Estates Subdivision, as shown on Warren County Tax Map 23A Sheets 1 through 6. B. Within the boundary lines of Apple Mountain Lake Subdivision as shown on Warren County Tax Map 22B. C. Within the boundary lines of all sections of Shenandoah Farms Subdivision and those adjacent parcels as shown on the following Warren County Tax Maps: 7A; 7A1; 15B; 15C; 15D, Sheets 1 and 2; 15E, Sheets 1 through 5; 15F; 15G; 15H; 23C, Sheets 1 through 9; and 24C. D. Within the boundary lines of all sections of Shenandoah Shores Subdivision as shown on Warren County Tax Map 13C, Sheets 1 and 2. E. Within or from the South Fork of the Shenandoah River from the upstream edge of the State Route 619 bridge to the confluence of the South Fork of the Shenandoah River with the North Fork of the Shenandoah River. F. Within the boundary lines of all sections of Lake Front Royal Subdivision as shown on Warren County Tax Map 39C. G. Within the boundary lines of all sections of Apple Mountain Lake South Subdivision as shown on Warren County Tax Map 31C. H. Within the boundary lines of all sections of High Knob Subdivision as shown on Warren County Tax Maps 31B and 31B1. I. Within the boundary lines of all sections of Stonewall Estates Subdivision as shown on Warren County Tax Map 11G.
method: Downloaded all 27,646 Warren County parcels from the county GIS (WarrenGISUpdates/Parcels, which carries tax map "map"+"ins" and a "subdivision" name field). For each lettered item, selected every parcel on the tax map(s) cited in the ordinance (e.g. 23A, 22B, 15E) plus any parcel whose subdivision field names that subdivision; unioned, 30 m morphological closing to absorb internal roads, holes < 5 ha filled, simplified 0.0001 deg, rounded to 5 decimals. Item E (river segment): TIGER 2023 area-water polygon "South Fork Shenandoah Riv" for Warren County, cut at the TIGER "State Rte 619" crossing, keeping the downstream piece to where TIGER switches to North Fork / Shenandoah River polygons (the confluence at Riverton). Cross-checked against Census 2023 CDPs: 95-100% of each subdivision polygon falls inside the same-named CDP (CDPs are larger).
notes: Subdivision items A-D, F-I are parcel-derived from the exact tax maps cited by the ordinance and agree with the county subdivision-name field; boundaries are lot-line unions so road rights-of-way/edges are approximated. Item C deliberately includes all parcels on the cited maps ("and those adjacent parcels") — including Linden Heights on 23C. Apple Mountain Lake West (22C) is NOT cited and not included. Item E is medium confidence: it relies on TIGER naming the road "State Rte 619" at the crossing near 38.904N -78.214W (south edge of Front Royal) and on TIGER water polygons; about 58% of that river segment lies within the Census boundary of the Town of Front Royal. The river feature has ordinance_item "E". Bow hunting by an owner on own property >=100 yd from residences/roads is excepted (not mapped).
recovered: Recovered 2026-11 from public/data/local-areas.geojson (the original source files were lost); geometry carries that layer's 30% simplification.
